evidence: X-ray diffraction (XRD) and X-ray reﬂectivity (XRR) analysis of the films were performed on a universal X-ray diffractometer ARL X'TRA (Thermo Fisher) using Cu K α radiation in Bragg –Brentano geometry. In addition to XRR measurements, the film thickness was evaluated with the laser ellipsometry using SE500adv (Sentech) instrument. The chemical composition of the films was investigated by ex situ X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) with XSAM-800 spectrometer (Mg Kα source, E = 1253.6 eV, 0.9 eV resolution on the Au 4f line). The reﬂection electron energy loss spectroscopy (REELS) technique employing the incident electrons at E = 500 eV was used to evaluate the effect of the film composition on the band gap. The capacitance–voltage (C–V) and current –voltage (I–V) curves were acquired at room temperature at a ramp rate 0.1 V/s using EPS1000 probe station (Ecorpia) and Agilent E4980A LCR-meter.
